nodes.name: Schedule Trigger
nodes.notes: Native hourly Schedule Trigger. Follow-ups are driven by this sweeper, NOT long Wait nodes.

nodes.name: Get Active Businesses
nodes.notes: Sequential read chain (live-validated topology): trigger -> businesses -> leads -> select. Active filtering happens in the Code node.

nodes.name: Get Leads Requiring Follow-up
nodes.notes: Reads ALL leads; due-lead selection happens in the Code node.

nodes.name: Select Follow-up Candidates
nodes.notes: Filters (all tenant-scoped): business active, status NOT booked/lost/closed/no_response, next_followup_at exists and <= now, followup_count < max_followups, valid email. Merges business config + HTML-escaped copies for the email template.

parameters.subject: ={{ 'Following up on your request — ' + $json.business_name }}
parameters.html:
={{ `

Hi ${$json._esc_name || 'there'},

We're following up on your request${$json._esc_service ? ' regarding ' + $json._esc_service + '' : ''} with ${$json._esc_business_name}. We'd love to help.

${$json.booking_link ? '

Book online here: Schedule now

' : ''}

Replying to this email reaches our team directly.

— ${$json._esc_business_name}

` }}

nodes.name: Send Follow-up Email
nodes.notes: FRESH native Email Send node (replaces obsolete n8n-nodes-base.sendEmail). Same proven SMTP credential. Reply-To reaches the business. n8n attribution disabled. onError isolates per-item failures: a bad recipient never blocks other candidates and never advances state.

nodes.name: End Failed Sends
nodes.notes: Error-output sink for failed sends. CRITICAL: failed leads skip Advance Follow-up State entirely, so followup_count and next_followup_at remain untouched and the lead is retried next sweep (TEST 7 isolation).

nodes.name: Advance Follow-up State
nodes.notes: Runs ONLY on successful sends (success output of Send Follow-up Email). Increments followup_count, sets last_contact_at, advances next_followup_at by followup_delay_hours. When followup_count reaches max_followups: status=no_response and next_followup_at cleared. Never contacts a lead indefinitely.

nodes.name: Update Lead Follow-up State
nodes.notes: Persists advanced state per candidate row matched by Column to Match On = lead_id ($json is the deterministic output of the preceding Code node — never Sheets output shape, never row_number).
